args.title: Make error toasts announced assertively and stay until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the aria-live attribute on error toasts to 'assertive' so screen readers announce them immediately. Also, prevent error toasts from auto-dismissing after 5 seconds, so they stay visible until the user dismisses them.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The toast error messages are currently announced with aria-live="polite" and auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, which is not appropriate for errors. This change will make error toasts use aria-live="assertive" for immediate announcement and remove their auto-dismiss timer so they stay until dismissed by the user.
